# truefoundry_team_budget_config (Resource)

Manages one team-scoped budget rule of AI gateway **budget limiting v2**: a spend cap on matching requests of one team, with optional alerting. Applied as a `team-budget-config` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. Rules are evaluated independently of each other and of tenant budgets — a request is blocked when any matching rule in `enforce` mode is over budget. Import an existing rule with `terraform import truefoundry_team_budget_config.example <name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A budget owned by one team. Team managers and tenant admins can manage it;
# it applies on top of any tenant budget that also matches the request.
resource "truefoundry_team_budget_config" "platform_per_user" {
  name      = "platform-per-user"
  team_name = "platform"
  mode      = "enforce"

  limits = {
    cost_per_day   = 1
    cost_per_month = 20
  }

  applies_to = {
    type = "per-user"

    overrides = [
      {
        users  = ["ada@example.com"]
        limits = { cost_per_day = 5 }
      },
    ]
  }

  when = {
    models = { in = ["gpt-4o"] }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `applies_to` (Attributes) How the budget is partitioned: one shared budget, or a separate budget per entity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applies_to))
- `limits` (Attributes) Spend caps in USD. Several periods can be set at once and each is enforced independently. Cost periods reset at 00:00 UTC (weekly on Mondays, monthly on the 1st, quarterly on Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct 1); `cost_per_lifetime` never resets and cannot be combined with the resetting periods — use a second rule for that. Usage counting starts when the rule is created — spend from earlier in the current period is not counted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `mode` (String) Enforcement mode. One of: `enforce`, `audit`. `enforce` blocks requests once the budget is exhausted, `audit` only tracks usage and still fires alerts.
- `name` (String) Name of the budget rule, unique within the tenant. Must start with a letter, end with a letter or digit, and contain only letters, digits, and hyphens (2-62 characters). Changing it replaces the rule.
- `team_name` (String) Name of the team that owns this budget. The control plane rejects unknown teams with `Invalid team id` and enforces RBAC on this value: team managers and tenant admins may manage the rule. Changing it replaces the rule.

### Optional

- `alerts` (Attributes) Alerting when usage crosses thresholds of the limit. Each threshold fires once per budget period; the checker runs every 20 minutes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alerts))
- `when` (Attributes) Requests this rule applies to; all given filters must match. Omit it to match every request within the rule's scope. Unlike budget limiting v1, rules are order-independent: every matching rule is evaluated and a request is blocked if any of them is over budget. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--when))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the budget rule.

<a id="nestedatt--applies_to"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applies_to`

Required:

- `type` (String) Partitioning. One of: `aggregate`, `per-user`, `per-model`, `per-virtual-account`, `metadata`. The control plane does not allow changing this after creation, so changing it replaces the rule.

Optional:

- `metadata` (String) Metadata key whose distinct values each get their own budget. Required when `type` is `metadata`, invalid otherwise.
- `overrides` (Attributes List) Per-entity limit overrides. Each entry names the entities it applies to — in the attribute matching `type` (`users`, `models`, `virtual_accounts`, or `metadata_values`) — plus its own limits. Not valid for `aggregate`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applies_to--overrides))

<a id="nestedatt--applies_to--overrides"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applies_to.overrides`

Required:

- `limits` (Attributes) Limits used for these entities instead of the rule's limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applies_to--overrides--limits))

Optional:

- `metadata_values` (Set of String) Metadata values this override applies to (`metadata` budgets only).
- `models` (Set of String) Models this override applies to (`per-model` budgets only).
- `users` (Set of String) Users this override applies to (`per-user` budgets only).
- `virtual_accounts` (Set of String) Virtual accounts this override applies to (`per-virtual-account` budgets only).

<a id="nestedatt--applies_to--overrides--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applies_to.overrides.limits`

Optional:

- `cost_per_day` (Number) Override daily cost in USD.
- `cost_per_lifetime` (Number) Override lifetime (never resets) cost in USD.
- `cost_per_month` (Number) Override monthly cost in USD.
- `cost_per_quarter` (Number) Override quarterly cost in USD.
- `cost_per_week` (Number) Override weekly cost in USD.




<a id="nestedatt--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits`

Optional:

- `cost_per_day` (Number) Maximum daily cost in USD.
- `cost_per_lifetime` (Number) Maximum lifetime (never resets) cost in USD.
- `cost_per_month` (Number) Maximum monthly cost in USD.
- `cost_per_quarter` (Number) Maximum quarterly cost in USD.
- `cost_per_week` (Number) Maximum weekly cost in USD.


<a id="nestedatt--alerts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alerts`

Required:

- `notification_targets` (Attributes Set) Receivers of the alerts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alerts--notification_targets))
- `thresholds` (Set of Number) Usage percentages of the limit at which to alert, e.g. [75, 90, 100].

Optional:

- `notify_breaching_user` (Boolean) Also notify the user who caused the breach. Only valid on `per-user` budgets.

<a id="nestedatt--alerts--notification_targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alerts.notification_targets`

Required:

- `notification_channel` (String) FQN of the notification channel integration to send through, e.g. my-tenant:slack:slack-webhooks:notification-channel:team-ai-foundation.
- `type` (String) Receiver type. One of: `email`, `slack-webhook`, `slack-bot`, `pagerduty`, `ms-teams-webhook`.

Optional:

- `channels` (Set of String) Slack channels to post to (slack-bot targets only).
- `to_emails` (Set of String) Recipient addresses (email targets only). The placeholder `{{user.email}}` resolves to the breaching user and is only valid on `per-user` budgets.



<a id="nestedatt--when"></a>
### Nested Schema for `when`

Optional:

- `metadata` (Attributes Map) Filters on request metadata, keyed by the metadata key from the `X-TFY-METADATA` header. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--when--metadata))
- `models` (Attributes) Models to match, by model name. Set `in`, `not_in`, or both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--when--models))
- `provider_accounts` (Attributes) Provider accounts to match — the account part of a model FQN, e.g. `openai-main`. Set `in`, `not_in`, or both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--when--provider_accounts))
- `subjects` (Attributes) Filters on the calling subject. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--when--subjects))

<a id="nestedatt--when--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `when.metadata`

Optional:

- `in` (Set of String) Match when the request's metadata values are in this list.
- `not_in` (Set of String) Match when the request's metadata values are not in this list.


<a id="nestedatt--when--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `when.models`

Optional:

- `in` (Set of String) Match when the request's values are in this list.
- `not_in` (Set of String) Match when the request's values are not in this list.


<a id="nestedatt--when--provider_accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `when.provider_accounts`

Optional:

- `in` (Set of String) Match when the request's values are in this list.
- `not_in` (Set of String) Match when the request's values are not in this list.


<a id="nestedatt--when--subjects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `when.subjects`

Optional:

- `teams` (Attributes) Teams to match. **Not valid on team budgets** — a team budget is already scoped to one team; the control plane rejects it. Set `in`, `not_in`, or both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--when--subjects--teams))
- `users` (Attributes) Users to match, by email. Set `in`, `not_in`, or both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--when--subjects--users))
- `virtual_accounts` (Attributes) Virtual accounts to match. Set `in`, `not_in`, or both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--when--subjects--virtual_accounts))

- `not_in` (Set of String) Match when the request's values are not in this list.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Budget rules are imported by their name; team_name comes from the stored
# manifest.
terraform import truefoundry_team_budget_config.platform_per_user platform-per-user
```
